request: Analyze NPC dialogue subtitle feasibility; no implementation or installation authorized in this analysis
verified_findings: The animation_scene coroutine spawns AnimationScene and a separate SoundSource, rather than calling play_video.
actor_kulibin.states_design.begin_talk associates an in-world progon1 animation with Kulib_Progon1 sound.
grsvt02.ds2edf defines SND_Gman as SoundSource with filename0 Operatciya GenSek2, in-world coordinates, head_mode false, looping false.
HUD configuration contains HudText/msg_string; cl_game.dll includes HUD_EVENT_SET_TEXT enum-generation and msg_string_show_time property strings.
The observed get_hud_element/hud_event Lua usage and engine.show_msg_string examples are commented out. No successful runtime subtitle display is demonstrated.
Animation-scene prototype explicitly disables hud_render during its scene, so merely placing text into the normal HUD would not prove visibility there.
conclusion: NPC dialogue is not uniformly prerecorded video. Existing burned-in AVI subtitle test cannot cover these world conversations. A new resource/script caption mechanism is only a hypothesis and must be demonstrated in an isolated runtime prototype before transcription/localization of all NPC speech is justified. No claim of universal impossibility.

web_sources.finding: Creator describes translating letters/text and video, explicitly leaving audio unlocalized.
Ukrainian localization describes text/notes/textures and voice dubbing, for old 1C edition; not evidence of a native NPC subtitle system.
